title: When Emotion Becomes Trigger: Emotion-style dynamic Backdoor Attack Parasitising Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.11612v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Data-poisoning backdoors pose a practical threat to the fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). Most existing attacks bind an attacker-selected behavior to fixed tokens, phrases, scenarios, or syntactic structures. These discrete triggers provide concrete handles for defenses based on local token anomalies, pattern matching, or trigger recovery. We found that, \emph{under semantics-preserving rewriting, emotionally styled inputs form representation clusters distinct from their neutral counterparts}. Meanwhile, de-emotionalised controls move back towards the neutral distribution. This observation motivates our method \textbf{Paraesthesia}, a dynamic backdoor attack that encodes its triggering condition in an emotional style. Paraesthesia maps target emotions into a valence--arousal space, rewrites a small subset of clean samples, and retains semantically faithful rewrites for fine-tuning. translated_title: 当情感成为触发器：寄生在大语言模型上的情感风格动态后门攻击
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.11612v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：数据投毒后门对大型语言模型（LLMs）的微调构成了实际威胁。现有的大多数攻击将攻击者选择的行为绑定到固定的令牌、短语、场景或句法结构上。这些离散触发器为基于局部令牌异常、模式匹配或触发器恢复的防御提供了具体抓手。我们发现，在保持语义的改写下，情感风格的输入形成了与中性对应物不同的表示聚类。同时，去情感化的对照样本会移回中性分布。这一观察启发了我们的方法**Paraesthesia**，一种动态后门攻击，将其触发条件编码在情感风格中。Paraesthesia将目标情感映射到效价-唤醒空间，改写一小部分干净样本，并保留语义忠实的改写用于微调。在指令遵循和分类任务中...
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Paraesthesia的动态后门攻击方法，利用情感风格作为触发条件，通过将情感映射到效价-唤醒空间并改写干净样本，实现对LLM微调过程的隐蔽攻击，突破了传统固定触发器易被防御的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Paraesthesia, a dynamic backdoor attack that uses emotional style as the trigger condition, mapping emotions into a valence-arousal space and rewriting clean samples to stealthily attack LLM fine-tuning, overcoming the limitations of fixed triggers that are easily defended.
